title: Recent advances in multicomponent synthesis of 5-substituted 1H-tetrazoles from aldehydes: catalytic methods and green chemistry approaches
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39642-39671
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06800B, Review Article
Open Access

Chou-Yi Hsu, Farag M. A. Altalbawy, Mohammed Asiri, Munthar Kadhim Abosaoda, Suhas Ballal, Abhayveer Singh, Anima Nanda, Subhashree Ray, Ahmed Remthan Hussein, Sadiq j. Baqir
This review highlights recent advancements in the catalytic synthesis of 5-substituted 1H-tetrazoles from aldehydes, focusing on improved efficiency, selectivity, and sustainability through various catalytic systems and green chemistry approaches.
